# Erdos.p1094 — Erdős problem 1094

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1094
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1094.lean`, theorem `erdos_1094`, AMS 11).

For all $n\ge 2k$ the least prime factor of $\binom{n}{k}$ is $\le\max(n/k,k)$, with only
finitely many exceptions.

## Statement
{(n, k) : ℕ × ℕ | 0 < k ∧ 2 * k ≤ n ∧ (n.choose k).minFac > max (n / k) k}.Finite

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
